ctx.x: Okay, but I'll tell you how this come out, though. We toured quite a few places around in the state with this Passing Pass in Review, and then we came back to Chicago after a few months out of Chicago, touring all around and in Iowa and what have you. And then this show, I think Leo booked the show South.
Well, at this time, this was 'way before Martin Luther King had had his walk.
